simulation.authorization: Actual Safe owners impersonated only on the isolated fork; each batch approved with approveHash and executed through Safe.execTransaction and MultiSendCallOnly. No production signatures were obtained. Gas uses pre-approved-hash signatures; actual signature and execution fees can differ.
simulation.note: No mainnet transaction submitted. Re-simulate in Safe before actual execution if state has changed.

safeImportValidation.checksums: Validated with the official Safe checksum serialization using ethers.
safeImportValidation.inputValidation: Every transaction value and function input is a string.
safeImportValidation.readableCalls: Uses contractMethod and contractInputsValues, omitting data so Safe renders safeTransferFrom arguments.
safeImportValidation.calldataValidation: All 469 calls were independently encoded with ethers using the Safe import path; byte-for-byte equal to the viem calldata executed on the fork.
